name: FastAPI AI Chat
description: A FastAPI chat app wired to a local model via [ai.default].
ai_hint: Expects a locally served model (e.g. `nerdit serve llama3.1:8b`); binds via [ai.default] provider=ollama.

name: Static Site
description: HTML/CSS/JS served by nginx-unprivileged — a non-root image that runs under the default sandbox.
ai_hint: Put the site under site/ (index.html is the entry point). Listens on 8080 as uid 101; do not switch to the stock nginx image — its root entrypoint fails under cap_drop=ALL.

name: Stripe Webhook
description: A FastAPI app that receives Stripe events through a Nerdit webhook.

env_schema.name: NERDIT_HOOK_STRIPE_SECRET
env_schema.description: The signing secret Stripe shows when you add the endpoint. Set it after the first deploy, once Stripe has the Webhook URL.

ai_hint: Declares [hooks.stripe] (path /webhooks/stripe). After deploy: share_service, then list_hooks for the Webhook URL; the user pastes it in Stripe (Developers > Webhooks > Add endpoint). The user sets the signing secret themselves (console Webhooks panel or `nerdit secrets set <app> --prompt NERDIT_HOOK_STRIPE_SECRET`); never ask for it in chat. Until it is set, deliveries are held, not lost.
